Scope and remaining work Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab: Multiple scattering, thermal emission, frequency redistribution, moving media and radiation–fluid coupling are unimplemented. This does not reproduce full DISORT functionality/stabilization. Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics: Coverage is observed over finite fixed seeds; neither exactly 95% empirical coverage nor all-seed success is guaranteed. Keep deterministic quadrature error separate from statistical error. Multiple scattering, frequency dependence, thermal emission and radiation hydrodynamics are unvalidated.
